Bind generation/evaluation separately through existing original/control/state.json (stage, job_id, request_path, request_sha256, RUN status), sealed Plan, per-condition primary metrics and rank reports. If original child request bytes are absent, label this narrower gap explicitly; do not invent the bytes or needlessly rerun computation.

findings.action: Add a compact, source-bound adaptation table covering what changed, what remained fixed, where it was approved/verified, and applicable limits. Do not change or re-audit the production algorithms.
